title: Critical role for the TGF-β1/mTORC1 signaling axis in defining the transcriptional identity of CTHRC1pathologic fibroblasts.
snippet: Fibrosis, marked by excess extracellular matrix (ECM) deposition, is the end stage of many diseases. Single-cell studies have highlighted the emergence of disease-specific fibroblast populations, including a high collagen-synthesizingsubpopulation.
